cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I spent six months learning birds. That's preparation with feathers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the birds were lucky I was ready. Now call it earned.

mechanism: A directs a quiz-newsletter account, allows the lucky subject draw to remain and bargains for the answers to be called earned.
confusable: Unlike asking for any praise, A insists the victory be attributed to preparation rather than chance.
comparison: Written account edits and bird study differ from a race winner conceding speed claims for preparation credit.
seedUse: D196-a bird quiz and luck; S02-a negotiates the account instead of repeating feather metaphors.
